hero.headline: Equip residential buildings for the future – with a competent technology partner
hero.subheadline: Adaptable, future-proof and economical system solutions for the housing industry
hero.intro: TCS is your competent technology partner for technical building equipment in multi-storey residential construction. With our core competence in door communication and a wide-ranging portfolio – from digital access control to resident information and hazard alerting – we create future-proof, standards-compliant and above all economical solutions. Our systems impress with high flexibility, long service life and easy expandability, which maximizes investment security for housing companies and at the same time enhances residents' self-determination.
hero.imageAlt: Modern residential complex with TCS entrance system

highlights.headline: Your benefits with TCS

solutions.headline: Solutions for your properties
solutions.intro: Well-thought-out systems for new construction, modernization and ongoing operation of your properties.

communication.label: Building communication
communication.headline: Professional intercoms for residential buildings
communication.text: Whether audio or video – TCS door intercoms provide your tenants with security and comfort. Thanks to IP technology and the snipdoo® app, residents can receive visitors and open doors from anywhere. Central administration via the BCM software simplifies tenant management.

access.label: Access control
access.headline: Manage keylessly – save costs
access.text: Lost keys, tenant changes, tradesperson access: with TCS access solutions you manage permissions digitally and avoid expensive lock changes. RFID, biometrics and app-based access offer maximum flexibility.

entry.label: Entrance systems
entry.headline: Entrance design that increases value
entry.text: The entrance area shapes the first impression. With the TCS Entry system you design mailbox, doorbell and name plates uniformly and to high quality – a clear advantage for re-letting and property valuation.

signage.label: Signage
signage.headline: Orientation throughout the neighborhood
signage.text: From house numbers to wayfinding systems and digital info displays: TCS signage solutions provide clear orientation in large residential complexes and increase the quality of stay.

tuersprechanlagen.label: Door communication
tuersprechanlagen.title: Next-generation door intercoms
tuersprechanlagen.text: Modular indoor stations for maximum flexibility

modular.title: Modular indoor stations
modular.desc: The future-proof indoor stations of the Senso Pro and Tasta Pro lines flexibly adapt to your needs. Initially installed as cost-effective audio hands-free units, tenants can independently expand them at any time via plug & play with video functions or mobile control devices. This significantly reduces initial investment costs for housing companies.

smartSticks.title: Mobile door communication via Smart Sticks
smartSticks.desc: The indoor stations can be expanded with plug-in Smart Sticks for smart and mobile functions. The Smart Stick Mobile Phone enables worldwide call answering and door opening via smartphone in conjunction with the TCS app. Existing landline telephones can be integrated via the Smart Stick DECT Global or the Smart Stick Phone. The door call can also be forwarded via Smart Stick to a socket-based wireless chime.

barrierefrei.label: Accessibility
barrierefrei.title: Age-appropriate and accessible living
barrierefrei.intro: TCS outdoor stations are equipped for visitors in compliance with DIN 18040-1 with color-backlit accessibility symbols. For residents, TCS offers preconfigured, wireless DECT solutions for special needs:

easyPro.name: DECT CONNECT Easy Pro
easyPro.desc: With hearing aid support for optimal communication

assistance.name: DECT CONNECT Assistance
assistance.desc: For blind and visually impaired users, wearable around the neck – call answering from anywhere

plugPlay.label: Plug & Play
plugPlay.title: Flexible video extensions and classic handsets
plugPlay.intro: Systems can be prepared as standard in 6-wire video technology ("video-ready"), which means that cost-effective audio indoor stations can be replaced individually per tenant with a video display module if required. For tenants who prefer classic and discreet operation, the system can easily be retrofitted with a handset set for two-way communication.

smartSticks.title: Smart Sticks
smartSticks.desc: Small modules to plug into the indoor station. Enable mobile door communication – optionally to the smartphone, to DECT phones, IP telephone systems or to a wireless chime.

videoModule.title: Video display module
videoModule.desc: On systems prepared as "video-ready", tenants can themselves add the video function to their basic station with a video display module – simply in exchange for the keypad module.

handset.title: Classic handset set
handset.desc: If a resident prefers more discreet operation, the indoor station can easily be equipped with a handset set for two-way communication.

plugPlay.noteProcurementText: Tenants can purchase the desired extensions directly online via the TCS tenant shop.
plugPlay.noteInstallationText: All components are installed by the tenant themselves as a plug & play solution – the housing company incurs neither installation effort nor additional costs.

mietershop.label: E-commerce
mietershop.title: The TCS tenant shop
mietershop.text: Equipment extensions directly and easily for the resident
mietershop.body: With the TCS tenant shop, residents can purchase individual product extensions – such as Smart Sticks, wireless chimes or video modules – online and put them into operation themselves without technical support. This way, the intercom systems meet individual needs while installation effort and costs for the housing company remain minimized.

namensanzeige.label: Administration
namensanzeige.title: Digital name display
namensanzeige.text: Central and efficient data management for tenant changes
namensanzeige.intro: Paper name plates are a thing of the past: tenant names are shown in modern fashion on digital displays at mailboxes, outdoor stations, bell panels and apartment doors. When tenants change, property managers can update the displays centrally, securely and conveniently via remote access from a PC – without any on-site effort and for the entire building portfolio.

central.title: Central control
central.desc: Edit and update tenant names at any time using software directly from the PC in the office.

comprehensive.title: Comprehensive update
comprehensive.desc: Transfer changes via remote access to displays at mailboxes, bell panels and floor buttons.

crossSite.title: Cross-location
crossSite.desc: Central remote access for the entire building portfolio at all locations.

efficient.title: High efficiency
efficient.desc: Quick and secure – manual replacement of paper name plates is completely eliminated.

access.title: Digital access control & parking management
access.desc: The powerful BCM system offers digital access control with central rights management for building entrances, interior areas and facilities such as container and bicycle parking spaces. Thanks to the modular system structure, digital parking management can also be integrated to intelligently and centrally control driveways and parking space usage as digital tenant rights.

info.title: Digital resident information
info.desc: Residents can be informed easily, centrally and in real time on digital info boards in the entrance area. Housing companies can communicate important dates such as meter readings, cleaning schedules or maintenance work. Particularly efficient: resident information is controlled via the same system as access control.

gefahrenalarmierung.label: Safety
gefahrenalarmierung.title: Hazard alerting and fire brigade announcement
gefahrenalarmierung.intro: Specifically designed for high-rise buildings, the door intercom system can be equipped with a fire brigade announcement function in order to alert all residential units simultaneously in case of danger.

coverage.title: Comprehensive alerting
coverage.desc: Since the door intercom is already connected to every residential unit, it can be used optimally for direct alerting of all tenants by the fire brigade – a decisive time advantage.

reliability.title: High reliability
reliability.desc: The system is designed as a reliable and standards-compliant solution that meets the high requirements of fire protection.

flexible.title: Flexible deployment options
flexible.desc: For the outdoor area the AD4 display outdoor station is used, for the indoor area the FDE fire brigade announcement unit in a protective cabinet – the location is determined in coordination with the fire brigade.

universal.title: Modernization of existing buildings and universal telephone
universal.desc: Defective door telephones in existing 1+n multi-wire technology systems from various manufacturers (such as Siedle, Ritto or Elkom) can be replaced quickly and cost-effectively with the TCS universal telephone. In addition, thanks to special TCS installation kits, existing outdoor stations, door side panels or mailbox systems can be equipped with new technology and continue to be used.

mailbox.title: Mailbox systems and signage systems
mailbox.desc: The TCS portfolio includes durable and flexibly configurable mailbox systems that can also be equipped with digital name plates and digital locks. The offering is complemented by illuminated and non-illuminated house numbers, door signs and escape and rescue plan signage for comprehensive stairwell equipment.

serviceGarantie.label: Service
serviceGarantie.title: TCS service, support and 5-year warranty
serviceGarantie.text: Reliable partnership for the entire life of an installation
serviceGarantie.body: As a system provider, TCS delivers not only technology but also powerful services from a single source. This ranges from configurators for installations through individual wiring diagrams and on-site commissioning to comprehensive maintenance offers. In addition, operators receive an extended quality warranty of 5 years for registered installations, which secures maximum reliability and investment protection.
